high_level_description: stc brand style, a close-up product photograph of a spherical wireframe drone.

compositional_deconstruction.background: A white surface with a blurred background and subtle shadows beneath the drone.

elements.desc: A black wireframe drone shaped as a regular icosahedron with 20 triangular faces, four propellers with blue and red LED lights mounted at its vertices, constructed from thin black metal rods and joints.
